title: A great day at the Alhambra!
text: While we were unable to get into the Nazrid Palace itself, it was still more than worth the visit to the Alhambra. Really a beautiful October day, enjoyed it immensely! Learned a lot about a part of the world. I knew very little about previously. Carlos was a great guide!

title: Alhambra & Generalife Garden

title: It was a wonderful...

author: Priscilla_E

title: Our Tour of Alhambra
text: What an exceptional tour. From pickup at the port to the tour of all of Alhambra was outstanding. Michael, our driver was prompt, courteous and above all safe. Antonio, our tour guide was the best. His knowledge and depth of the history of Alhambra and Granada was fascinating. His pace and cadence of the tour made the walk a pleasure.  His ability to express his love and passion as a tour guide shines through with every bit of history he explained. We didn’t want the tour to end.
author: 85stewartk
